invariants.rationale: The map is dereferenced to getTiledSets() and potentially used to create objects, so must not be null.
The objects collection is always used and added to; it must be non-null.
element is dereferenced continuously (getName(), getFloatAttribute(), etc.), so must be non-null.
heightInPixels is subtracted from attribute values and used as a graphical measurement, so negative values would likely be invalid.
A child count should never be negative.
